Synopsis:
    Mexican authorities uncovered a clandestine crypto mining farm in the mountainous Puebla region, the fourth such discovery since early last year, suspected of being operated by drug cartels to launder illicit funds. The operation — powered potentially via stolen electricity from a nearby hydroelectric dam — reflects a broader trend of Latin American criminal organizations moving into crypto-based financial crime. Chainalysis data shows illicit crypto transactions surged to $154B globally in 2025. Analysts warn crypto-related crime will continue growing as adoption widens, even as law enforcement capabilities improve.

Relevance: NO — the article focuses on Mexican cartel activity, crypto crime in Latin America, and global illicit crypto flows. No direct connection to US equities or macro.
